Website Portfolio

An interactive portfolio with a standard GUI and a command-driven terminal mode powered by shared content sources.

SvelteKit ·TypeScript ·Tailwind CSS ·mdsvex

source code live demo

Overview

This project explores how to present a software profile through two interfaces: web-native navigation and terminal-style interaction. Both surfaces are backed by the same content model to avoid drift.

Architecture

  • Dynamic routes for project detail pages
  • Markdown-driven content pipeline with metadata
  • Shared command parser for CLI mode

Outcome

The result is a memorable portfolio experience that still remains practical to maintain and extend.
